checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Uses a frame from the clip, retaining identity and source appearance
must.why: Background is a newly generated kitchen and the woman was regenerated. Hair is darker and straighter, and the sweater is gone. The smile is different and the face looks like a similar but different person.
Face is fully visible, though it is AI-smoothed.

must.item: Headline reads exactly MORNINGS MADE EASY, large, beside face
must.why: Large white letters with an outline are on the left, spelled correctly.
Golden warm kitchen tones and a smile.

faults.what: The woman was regenerated by AI. Hair colour and style differ (no highlights or waves), the smile is closed instead of the open one, and the face is smoothed and looks like a different person. Her recognisability is not kept.
The background is an invented kitchen, not the real one from the clip.
The image is low resolution (640x360) and looks AI-painted.
The face crop used as the source was tiny and blurry.

summary: The thumbnail has correct, big, warm-styled text, but the woman is an AI-regenerated lookalike in an invented kitchen rather than a real frame from the clip, so her identity is not reliably kept.
